output.subject: Invoice INV-1187: $28,000
output.body:
Hello Evergreen Home team,

Our records show invoice INV-1187 for $28,000 is due Dec 10. Could you let me know when we can expect payment? If you can pay it by the due date, Dec 10, it would help us a great deal with our year-end commitments.

If anything is holding it up, please tell me and I will help sort it out.

Thank you,
Cascade Trade Co.
